shared_elements: row of repeated curved/arched forms along the top
horizontal banding dividing the field into registers
abstract curvilinear/geometric motifs without background filling
justification: Both surfaces organise shallow, flat-toned relief into stacked registers, with a top row of repeated curved forms above a horizontal division and paired ring/disc motifs and bird-like profile creatures below, which is a reasonably specific correspondence. The decisive difference is the carrier and overall impression: A is a broad rectangular panel with crisp, incised, narrative-looking figures (including a clear snake and net-like band), whereas B is a weathered, three-dimensional standing monolith whose motifs are soft, bulging and largely abstract, so the wholes read as entirely different objects.
